content.comment_body: I am trying to use [product_name] [article_no] for controlling my home wiring. I already have the necessary programs but I'm finding it difficult to purchase [product_name] and all required accessories in Nigeria. I reached out to the contact person at [company_name] Nigeria, but was informed they don't sell [company_name] products to individuals. Is this accurate? Can anyone on this forum help direct me on how to obtain these items from [company_name]? I need a power supply, three units of [product_name] [article_no], a switch, six units of [product_name] DM16, and [product_name] TD, but I'm struggling to source them. Even after sending my program to the contact person, they maintained that sales aren't made to individuals. How can I acquire these parts since my project is time-sensitive? The current program for the house wiring is attached, with room for changes.
Ask [company_name] Nigeria which companies they do sell to. Then contact those companies and see if they can handle the transaction for you.
That's a helpful suggestion. I will definitely try that. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is encountering challenges in sourcing required [company_name] hardware and components for a home automation project due to a local sales policy preventing direct individual purchases in Nigeria. This causes frustration and urgency as project timelines are at risk, illustrating the impact of purchase restrictions and accessibility issues for end users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to purchase [company_name] products and accessories easily as an individual customer, with prompt support to prevent project delays.
